seed_memories: prefers US sellers; no Alibaba or AliExpress
notes: Second demo (PLAN §13.2). README pinned to commit c78ad15e; GPL-3.0: we read its parts list and use none of its code. Digi-Key is left out: it is disabled in data/stores.json until P11 (the API key) exists; add 'digikey' to allowed_merchants only then. Adafruit and SparkFun are in on purpose (product-link stores): the mandate is not shaped to manufacture a failure.
